newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - October 17.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - October 17.

text.p: The Federal Reserve had no large one-day net misses in its reserve projections, a Fed spokesman said.

As for the pattern of borrowing, about 37 percent of the adjustment borrowing for the week was done by the large regional banks, while about 63 percent of the borrowing was done by the money centers. No borrowing was done by the small banks.

As for the pattern of borrowing on Wednesday, less than 1/4 percent of one percent of the borrowing was done by the small banks, whle less than 1/2 of one percent was done by the large regional banks. A bit over 99 percent of the borrowing was done by the money centers.
The high in natural float was about $3.6 billion on Wednesday, while the low was about $350 million on Friday.
Transportation float averaged a bit under $100 per day with the high on Wednesday at about $575 million primarily due to weather related delays in several eastern cities.
